decisions.rationale: Dermatomyositis is a broader class of diseases that includes ipilimumab-induced dermatomyositis.
Drug-induced cutaneous eruption with myositis is not a precise subtype of ipilimumab-induced dermatomyositis, and the relationship is not exact.

Dermatomyositis is a broader class of diseases that includes ipilimumab-induced dermatomyositis.
